summary: All 11 selected genes with readable published directions agreed with the registered ARC fasting result. JCI reported Agrp, Lepr and Npy at FDR < 0.03, while none passed registered FDR < 0.05. Pomc was the only published fitted effect: −0.52 versus −0.5133 registered. This falls below the 30-pair concordance minimum. The proposal and evidence were saved without editing any ledger. [JCI article](https://www.jci.org/articles/view/97007) · [PNAS appendix](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/files/S-EPMC5584443/pnas.1707310114.sapp.pdf)
openIssues: No genome-wide author coefficient table was located for wild-type ARC fasting. JCI Supplemental Table 2 covers adult deletion experiments.
The public sources do not identify the excluded libraries individually or establish why the selected adjusted-P calls differ.
